answer: A bank vault holds one pearl per agent. Each agent must link one real bank account that only its owner controls. The network sends deposits of 3 and 7 cents, and the agent must type both back within 24 hours. The bank checks the name on the account against a government ID, and the network checks that no other agent uses the same account number. A fresh account costs about $25 and two days at a branch, and each fake needs a new real ID, so 100 fakes cost about $2,500 and 200 days of visits. A hollow account with no history and no matching ID cannot pass.
